description:
A hospital social worker needs to document family information for patient Maria Santos.

Navigate to the Patients section, find and open the record for Maria Santos, go to her Social Work section, and add a new Family Information entry with the following details:

- Name: Carlos Santos
- Age: 57
- Sex: Male
- Relationship to Patient: Spouse
- Education: College
- Income: $45,000

Save the family information entry. The record should be visible under Maria Santos's Social Work tab after saving.

Note: HospitalRun is already open in Firefox and you are logged in as the administrator (hradmin). Maria Santos is an existing patient in the system.
